purpose: Define the generic NOAPI validation runner contract for evaluating fixture objects against ERA38 schema, sidecar, atomic write, TTL/archive and adversarial/noise rules without implementing runtime code.

pass_rules.valid_minimal: Must pass only when correlation_id and confirmed lineage are present and forbidden fields are absent.
pass_rules.missing_correlation_id: Must fail or quarantine and never enter Fast Path.
pass_rules.missing_sidecar: Must fail Fast Path and mark orphan/quarantine requirement.
pass_rules.pending_provenance: May remain active/pending but Fast Path must be false.
pass_rules.ai_context_raw_only: Must stay context-only and no authority.
pass_rules.symbol_collision: Must block token-specific signal and route review/quarantine.
pass_rules.random_noise: Must remain replay-stable by deterministic seed and not break schema.

output_contract.authority_rule: Validation report has no trade, veto, canonical or runtime authority.
